caption: The drawing depicts two ceramic bowls with notched rims, having a primarily yellow or light brown base color. The upper bowl is shown from above, featuring a central green and brown floral motif with multiple leaves or petals radiating outward. Around the rim, there is an inscription in a script resembling German, written in a circular pattern. The lower bowl, also shown from above, displays a similar color scheme and floral pattern, with green and brown leaf forms radiating from the center and additional green decorations spaced around the inner rim. Both bowls have a notch or indentation in the rim at the same orientation, and the shadows and highlights suggest a three-dimensional effect. The background of the drawing is plain and off-white, and there is a signature "E.H. Shellard 57" near the bottom right of the lower bowl.
title: Pa. German Shaving Basin
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
